notes.title: Achievements
notes.notes:
Hi all!

You asked we listened. Now you can collect 20 achievements through the whole game!
Let's start exploring!

Cheers,
Michal and Tereza

notes.title: Turkish localization and gamepad support
notes.notes:
Hi all,

We are excited to announce that we now have complete Turkish localization thanks to Uygar Kibar / Wordarch Studio. Our game is now translated into 17 languages, which is awesome.

We also prepared gamepad controls. That required slight changes to the UI icons, but we think everything is now much better. Please let us know how you like it and if you encountered any problems.

Happy new year!
Tereza and Michal

notes.title: Index of Plants and Animals
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34357785/abbcc271551f40a492d76d72c3d4b2da49e4a5cc.png[/img]

With the arrival of the school, we are announcing a new game upgrade. You will find now an INDEX in the application that will make it easier for you to orientate in the game and simplify the search for animals and plants that you may have forgotten their names. We are launching a new version of Little mouse's encyclopedia today. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34357785/a45f8d515e26a5b20add086937de96e833660d82.jpg[/img]

Discover nature and have fun!
Your Mouse
